en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4260 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih who said:

I saw Abu Abdillah (as) using a toothpick, so I looked at him.
Imam (as) said: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) used a toothpick, and it purifies the mouth."
